from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single paper regarding its citation relationships."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper currently being processed")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers explicitly cited or referenced in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitationInfo]
